author: kycrafft
body:
So far, I like credit amounts for the most part, but I think the games would be more interesting if there were more options for credits. Here's a list of examples (these are the base credits, rank multipliers  will still apply)



  • 5 killstreak in Nexus or CTH: +4 credits
  • 10 killstreak in nebula +7 credits
  • Survive the first 10 minutes of a walls game +10 credits
  • Survive the first 5 minutes of SG +6 credits
  • Pick up a wool +3 credits
  • Kill a wool carrier +3 credits
  • Shoot someone from farther than 50 blocks +5 credits  
  • 3 or more monuments in one game +15 credits


Existing credit tweaks (extra suggestions):
  • Kill in walls 2 -> 5 credits
  • Nexus 10 killstreak 5(?) -> 15 credits
I'd like to know everyone's opinion on this.
